title: Mega private capital deals worth $18bln defy regional tensions in the GCC
summary: Long-term investors, particularly those with deep-rooted ties to Gulf sovereign wealth funds built over decades, remain willing to deploy capital into strategic regional assets

contentHtml:
The UAE, home to the ADGM and DIFC financial centres, where many of the world’s leading private capital firms have established regional bases, remains at the forefront of the Middle East’s private capital ecosystem Image courtesy: Getty Images/Klaus Vedfelt

Long-term investors, particularly those with deep-rooted ties to Gulf sovereign wealth funds built over decades, remain willing to deploy capital into strategic regional assets

While uncertainty stemming from the Iran–US conflict has weighed on credit markets and constrained traditional fundraising in the GCC, two mega private market deals announced this week underscore the resilience of investor appetite in the region.
